يستظرفون (form X)
# يَسْتَظْرِفُونَ (yastaẓrifūna) /jas.taðˤ.ri.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
# يُسْتَظْرَفُونَ (yustaẓrafūna) /jus.taðˤ.ra.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
